review.name: Azure Ryujin
findings: Original source twelve raw face/body slices and all 216 actual equipped-technique frames inspected. Lower jaw drifts; old standing attack hind support slides 0.3014 and casting front foot sinks 0.06916. Four independently frozen visible sole surfaces 335/318/289/303 inspected in four overlay views. Candidate V2 fits four leg chains to the sculpt and rebinds old sections by continuous visible height. Original 21 frames/inverses and mesh/texture data conserved. Candidate all twelve raw slices and all 216 native actual-technique frames inspected and pass. At 481 times per action support drift is below 0.000113 and floor below 0.000078; both front attack paws intentionally lift 0.035. All source sole head/neck contributions zero. Frozen face 922 clip poses plus 468 blends pass, whole skull 2177 vertices pass, full geometry 483 poses zero warnings. Final rebuilt battle and repeat review pending.

Final second pass actually inspected all 24 raw source/battle face/body slices, 32 low/medium production transition slices, 24 advancing idle frames, all 216 actual equipped-technique frames in twelve lossless native strips, and all sixteen atlas cells. All pass. Source/battle independently frozen face and complete-head probes pass, with zero full-geometry warnings at 483 poses each. Twelve anatomical regression tests plus three animation-bank tests and production build pass. V1 had 383 geometry warnings and was numerically rejected without visual approval; fixed legacy shoulder bindings by visible sculpt height. Whole-roster and live release remain pending.

companionTechniqueAudit.label: independent-mythic-006-anatomical-v2-final-techniques
companionTechniqueAudit.finding: All nine actual equipped techniques inspected front and side at twelve times. Complete jaw, horns and whiskers retain shape; shoulders, short legs, belly and tail remain connected. Both forepaws lift together during attack, with both rear soles supporting; cast and recoil retain four supports.
